Pancreozymin (BAN) CCK-PZ; Pancreocimina; Pankreotsymiini; Pankreozymin. ATC — V04CK02. ATC Vet — QV04CK02. NOTE. The endogenous hormone is known as cholecystokinin (CCK). Units The potency of pancreozymin may be expressed as Crick-Harp- er-Raper units based on the pancreatic secretion in cats or as Ivy dog units based on the increase in gallbladder pressure. One Ivy dog unit is considered to be approximately equivalent to 1 Crick- Harper-Raper unit. Profile Pancreozymin is a polypeptide hormone prepared from the duo- denal mucosa of pigs. When given by intravenous injection it 2362 Supplementary Drugs and Other Substances causes an increase in the secretion of pancreatic enzymes and stimulates gallbladder contraction.
